result.title: Look Closer, Align Better: Explicit Visual Attributes for Robust EEG-to-Image Decoding
result.summary: EEG-to-image retrieval commonly aligns neural responses with representations from pretrained vision encoders. However, these representations may underrepresent fine-grained visual details needed to distinguish semantically similar images. To address this limitation, we first investigate the EEG decodability and complementary predictive value of explicit visual attributes, identifying visual cues that capture EEG-relevant information beyond pretrained representations. Building on these findings, we propose AttrEcho, a framework that enriches pretrained visual representations with complementary, spatially aligned visual attributes. Specifically, Region-Aligned Visual Attribute Fusion (RAVF) integrates EEG-relevant local visual attributes with spatially corresponding pretrained features through a learnable signed residual gate. We further employ Feature Token Aggregation (FTA), which learns dimension-specific weights across regions to aggregate refined visual features for contrastive alignment with EEG representations. Experiments on THINGS-EEG demonstrate that AttrEcho achieves 94.8% Top-1 and 99.7% Top-5 accuracy in intra-subject 200-way retrieval, while maintaining 82.1% Top-1 accuracy as the gallery expands to 1,600 images with same-concept distractors. AttrEcho also achieves 25.3% Top-1 and 53.0% Top-5 accuracy in inter-subject retrieval. These results highlight the importance of EEG-relevant visual attributes and spatially aligned fusion for fine-grained EEG-to-image retrieval.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究EEG到图像检索，先验证显式视觉属性对EEG的可解码性与互补信息，再提出AttrEcho：用区域对齐的属性融合（可学习符号残差门）把EEG相关局部属性注入空间对应的预训练特征，并以特征token聚合做对比对齐，在THINGS-EEG上报告检索结果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「预训练视觉表示缺乏细粒度细节、需按空间对齐补充显式属性」的思路，可能为LVR中视觉细节如何进入内部表示、以及属性级证据筛选提供可供核查的方法线索，但EEG检索任务与VLM推理相距较远。
